answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 2158 Country: India Title: Please, clarify if the breast of one's wife is without milk and there is no chance of going the milk inside the mouth of husband, is it allowed to suck the breast of wife? Question: Please, clarify if the breast of one's wife is without milk and there is no chance of going the milk inside the mouth of husband, is it allowed to suck the breast of wife? Answer ID: 2158 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 596/594=M) Husband can lick the breast of her wife but he can not drink her milk. Her milk is haram for him to consume. It is better to avoid taking breast in mouth if he fears discharge of milk. Hoverer, if the milk was discharged it should not be taken in but spit. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
